chunks: Remember when you killed a man and blamed each other for the deed, God brought to light what you concealed.
ai.seo_question: What is the story of the killed man in Surah Al-Baqarah?
ai.summary: This verse references the incident of the Banu Israel killing a man and disputing over the culprit, which led to the divine command to sacrifice a cow as a test of their obedience. In Shia exegesis, this event is often viewed as a precursor to the trial of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the Ahl al-Bayt, highlighting the theme of divine knowledge exposing hidden truths amidst human conflict.
